notes:
- 3D converter: conversions that go through several engines (e.g. STEP → FBX, 3MF → FBX, DWG → STL, STEP → 3MF) now really save the file next to the original – before, the result was lost
- 3D converter: real-world size and the same orientation in every direction – a 200 mm CAD part is 0.2 m in GLB/FBX/USD and stands upright; FBX → GLB and 3MF → GLB no longer come out 100–1000× too big; GLB/FBX → STEP keeps the true size
- 3D converter: STL and 3MF made from models with real units (GLB, FBX, 3MF, DAE) are written for 3D printing – millimetres, Z up – so they stand in the slicer at true size
- 3D converter: CAD assemblies keep their parts as separate objects in FBX/USD; USD no longer writes a stray background texture
- 3D converter: clear message when a STEP file holds only a mesh (IGES can't be made from it) and readable engine errors instead of progress output
- 3D converter window: the "Which format?" header stays visible; scale hint for formats without units
